name: TimeLoop
summary: A calendar app that can rebuild your day from what you say or type, with a lasting free plan and a Pro subscription.
description: TimeLoop is a schedule app for iPhone, Android, Mac and the web: the Free plan lets you plan the day by hand, shuffle a late day with a tap, and sync with phone and Google calendars, with no card and no end date (€0/month). TimeLoop Pro adds planning from what you say or type, leaving-time estimates and more. On app.trytimeloop.com the price is in euros, VAT included; other-country store prices are shown before you subscribe. One Pro subscription covers all signed-in devices.

pricing.details: Free 0 €/month, no card, no end date. Pro 4.99 €/month or 29.99 €/year (2.49 €/month when billed yearly). Official euro web prices as of October 2026, VAT included. One Pro subscription covers all signed-in devices.
